frozen_note: Problem, domain, boundary conditions, force and averaging procedure, frozen before any 2-D cylinder run and before an acceptance band was chosen. The band lives in a separate file (cyl2d_band.json), frozen after this one and also before any run. Neither changes after a result.
purpose: 2-D solver-fidelity control for the planned resolved fin-section packet (claude-07 protocol work/fin-patch@f8ebc13). Passing it would not erase the failed 3-D sphere gate C1, would not validate fin sections at Re_c 2500-9900, 3-D fins or flight, and is not biological validation.

reference_problem.source: Qu, Norberg, Davidson, Peng & Wang 2013, J. Fluids Struct., doi 10.1016/j.jfluidstructs.2013.02.007, author manuscript (sha256 1a67139ea4d70d4149a66506c663e185ed927c48bd4a4396cdb13270fc30c73b); read by mechanobio, Tables 2 and 3 re-read here with pdftotext from the same file
reference_problem.their_setup: uniform inlet, lateral free-stream condition, no-slip cylinder, convective outlet at U_inf; square domain H (in D) centred on the cylinder; body-fitted O-mesh, near-wall cell 0.0054 D
reference_problem.matched_row: Table 2 case D4 (H = 60, 386 x 210, dt 0.02) for the H = 60 runs; case D2 (H = 120, 386 x 322, dt 0.02) for the H = 120 domain diagnostic

scaling.St: f D / U_inf, f the lift frequency
scaling.coefficients: per unit span, on 0.5 rho U_inf^2 D (rho = 1 in grid units)

solver.code: WaterLily.jl 1.10.0, pinned env engineering/cfd3d/env (CPU) and env_gpu (GPU)

domain.shape: square, side H = 60 D, cylinder centre at (30 D, 30 D) from the lower-left interior corner: 30 D upstream, 30 D downstream, 30 D to each lateral face
domain.grid: uniform Cartesian, h = D / n_D; runs use n_D = 32 and 64

boundary_conditions_as_implemented.lateral: free-slip: v = 0 Dirichlet, du/dy = 0 Neumann (core.jl:241-244). DIFFERS from Qu's free-stream lateral condition; the size of that difference is not quantified by Qu
boundary_conditions_as_implemented.outlet: convective: exitBC = true, 1-D convection at the inflow mean speed with a mass-flux correction (core.jl:256-264); conceptually close to Qu's convective outlet at U_inf, equivalence not established

initial_condition: u = (U, 0) everywhere plus a declared symmetry-breaking v bump 0.01 U exp(-|x - c - (2D, 0)|^2 / D^2), discarded with the transient

time.averaging_window: from the first lift up-crossing after t = 100 to the last lift up-crossing before t_end: whole periods only

forces.total: Cd = -2 total_force(sim)[1] / (U^2 D), Cl = -2 total_force(sim)[2] / (U^2 D): pressure plus viscous stress (Metrics.jl:188); minus because WaterLily returns the force on the fluid
forces.sampling: every time step, recorded with its time

frequency.method: lift up-crossings (linear interpolation in t) inside the averaging window; period = mean spacing; St = D / (U * mean period)
frequency.uncertainty: std of periods / mean period, and the count of periods
frequency.periodic_state_required: at least 20 whole periods in the window and period CV <= 0.02; otherwise the run is recorded as NO PERIODIC STATE (a failure, not a reason to change the window)

surface_pressure_internal_check.what: 720 equally spaced angles; p sampled with WaterLily.interp at r = R + 1.5 h, R + 2.5 h, R + 3.5 h, extrapolated quadratically to r = R; Cp = (p - p_ref) / (0.5 U^2), p_ref = mean p over the inlet plane interior at the same step
surface_pressure_internal_check.time: time mean of the per-sample Cp over the averaging window, sampled every 10th step
surface_pressure_internal_check.integral: Cd_p_surface = -sum(Cp * n_x * R dtheta) / (0.5 D) over the 720 points
surface_pressure_internal_check.role: INTERNAL consistency between wall-extrapolated surface pressure and the solver's pressure_force; not a comparison with Qu and not a validation of total drag

R3_domain.role: domain diagnostic: same grid as R1, Qu's H = 120

M1_mutant.role: viscosity x4; must not pass the band

not_in_scope: 3-D effects (2-D shedding at Re 100 is physical: below the ~190 3-D wake transition, recalled), any fin section, any flight or swimming claim
